assumptions.statement: Site and key-area geometries are provisional_rough temporary substitutes, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All derived areas and maps must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Official redlines, FAR, height and demolition controls are missing; all spatial controls are conceptual suggestions pending official data.
assumptions.impact: Metrics and geometries must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Three key-area polygons are provisional extents for design discussion only.
assumptions.impact: Key-area detailed design anchors are conceptual until official extents are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Shade/green-view/enclosure/stay/night indices are provisional model estimates, not sensor or survey measurements.
assumptions.impact: Priority ranks are directional; SP-Survey and field re-survey required before implementation claims.

assumptions.statement: This submission includes a deployable SP-Survey protocol but does not claim completed field responses.
assumptions.impact: Human preference results are future inputs to iteration, not current scoring evidence.

assumptions.statement: Robot low-speed shared corridors and hubs are conceptual design layers using local_access/branch road classes and custom facility_role attributes; they are not designated legal lanes or approved robot rights-of-way.
assumptions.impact: Any pilot requires traffic, fire, property and operator approvals; speed cap ≤6 km/h is a design intention only.

assumptions.statement: No personal trajectory, facial recognition or sensitive profiling is required for any scenario; aggregation and purpose limitation are mandatory.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios that cannot meet minimization must not proceed to pilot.

assumptions.statement: High-risk AI and robot scenarios require human review, emergency stop, appeal and rollback; display is not validation.
assumptions.impact: Failed safety thresholds block city pilots.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height and density remain unknown; S1/S2/S3 intensity envelopes are method frames without numeric commitments.
assumptions.impact: No intensity figure may be treated as approved control.

assumptions.statement: Transit station doors, road redlines and ridership data are unavailable; connection lines express priority only.
assumptions.impact: No bridge/signal design is authorized by this package.

assumptions.statement: Municipal, power and charging capacities are unknown; robot charging and compute suggestions are feasibility topics only.
Accessibility geometry is conceptual until surveyed slopes, crossings and tactile systems are verified.
assumptions.impact: PERCEPKIT components stay demountable until certified.

assumptions.statement: Brand marks, seals and classical visual code are design identity, not trademark clearance.
assumptions.impact: Formal branding requires IP clearance before public deployment.

assumptions.statement: Phasing years and annual programs are design roadmaps, not government investment or procurement commitments.
assumptions.impact: Operators and budgets must be separately confirmed.

assumptions.statement: assets/renders/* are concept architectural visualizations, not photographs of built conditions or approved schemes.
assumptions.impact: Do not use renders as evidence of existing place quality or statutory compliance.

assumptions.statement: First-person railway drama scenes are narrative devices, not historical assertions or evidence.
assumptions.impact: Do not treat drama text as source facts.

assumptions.statement: Urban design and urban science citations (Lynch, Gehl, Jacobs, Whyte, Space Syntax, 15-minute city, Complete Streets, CPTED, PPS, NACTO, etc.) are methodological background for translating mechanisms; they are not statutory standards for Haidian and do not claim local empirical validation.
assumptions.impact: Do not treat theory citations as compliance proof or as measured local scores (e.g. Walk Score, space-syntax integration) unless recalculated with approved data.
